summary: Apply one explicit sequence-specific non-Cartesian phase model to a non-Cartesian k-space frame.
notes: This is intentionally not an alias of phase_correct and does not accept the Cartesian ksj.phase-model, whose [channel,kx] layout cannot express arbitrary non-Cartesian sample association. A future exact contract must define the non-Cartesian phase-model layout, trajectory/sample and sequence semantics, calibration key compatibility, finite resource bounds, completion, and terminal behavior. Its model arrives only through an explicit calibration binding.
